salary_cap.carryover: Unused room carries over in full (up to 100%).

rookie_scale_2026.note: Signed (or OverTheCap-listed) 2026 rookie contracts for every pick: years, total, average per year, guaranteed.

fifth_year_option.decision: After the player's third season, deadline early May (May 1 in 2026)
fifth_year_option.guarantee: Fully guaranteed once exercised; any unguaranteed fourth-year base salary also becomes guaranteed

tiers.salary: Franchise tag amount for the position
Transition tag amount for the position

tiers.criteria: 75%+ snaps in two of three seasons, or 75%+ average over three seasons, or 50%+ in all three seasons
tiers.salary: Average of the 3rd-20th highest salaries at the position over five years

fifth_year_option.position_groups: All offensive linemen are one group

rules: One franchise or transition designation per club per year
Exclusive tag: greater of the top-5 average salary at the position (as of April 17) or the non-exclusive amount
Non-exclusive tag: two first-round picks as compensation if the player signs elsewhere

free_agency.RFA: 3 accrued seasons, with a qualifying offer
free_agency.accrued_season: 6+ regular-season games on active/inactive, reserve/injured or reserve/PUP list

practice_squad.eligibility: Rookies and second-year players with fewer than 9 active games; up to 10 with no more than two accrued seasons; up to 6 with no limit on seasons; those two groups together at most 10.

roster_limits.post_cut_ir: Two players may go to IR by the cutdown and return later
roster_limits.waivers: Players with fewer than 4 accrued seasons go on waivers; claims due Aug 31, 1 p.m. ET

calendar_2026.playoffs: Wild card Jan 16-18, 2027; divisional Jan 23-24; conference Jan 31; Super Bowl LXI Feb 14 at SoFi Stadium

gaps: 2027 fifth-year option amounts by position (only per-player estimates found)
2027 salary cap: no official projection found
The full compensatory formula is not public (the NFL names its inputs only)

rfa_tenders_2026.rule: Each is the greater of the amount or 110% of the player's 2025 Paragraph 5 salary. Offer sheets due Apr 17, 2026; first-refusal decision Apr 22.

game_day.emergency_third_qb: A bona fide QB on the 53 may be listed as emergency third QB when only two QBs are active; he may enter only if both are out by injury or disqualification, and must leave if one is cleared.

injured_reserve.designated_to_return: Up to 8 per regular season (10 for playoff teams), plus 2 placed at the final cutdown; each player can return twice
injured_reserve.pup: Active/PUP in camp; reserve/PUP misses at least the first 4 games; cannot go on PUP after practicing

compensatory_picks.basis: Net loss of compensatory free agents, valued by salary, playing time and postseason honors
compensatory_picks.minority_hiring_picks: A team that loses a minority head coach or top football executive to another team's top job gets a 3rd-round pick in each of the next two drafts (after the round-3 comp picks)

cap_mechanics.void_years: Placeholder years for proration; bonus left on them accelerates when the contract voids
cap_mechanics.release_before_june_1: All remaining prorated bonus hits this year's cap
cap_mechanics.post_june_1: Up to 2 designations a year; this year keeps its normal proration, the rest moves to next year
cap_mechanics.minimum_cash_spending: 90% of the caps over 2021-23, 2024-26 and 2027-30; any shortfall is paid to the players
